definition: Place orders at fixed steps above and below a price so that, together, the positions they open reach a combined profit and close as one.
boundaries: Known failure: a trend that does not come back leaves every order open against it; the run of finished cycles ends with one the deposit cannot carry. Named so a unit, a source or he can point at it; its maths is the risk session's.
recognition: Orders sit at regular steps and are closed together in profit.

sources.quote: these orders gain enough profit at some point to close them all at once
this inevitably ends with a cycle when the deposit is insufficient
